summary: Adam Dennis, 38, of Aspen, killed in an avalanche while skiing with a group of five in Desolation, just south of Maroon Bowl outside the Aspen Highlands boundary
location: Desolation (south of Maroon Bowl, outside Aspen Highlands boundary)
responding_agency: Pitkin County Sheriff's Office, Mountain Rescue Aspen
notes: Report received 2:45 p.m. Monday; companions located him and attempted CPR unsuccessfully. Deputies and Mountain Rescue Aspen assessed snow stability and planned the recovery for Tuesday. CAIC rated danger considerable above treeline, moderate below; the slide occurred below treeline after 12+ in of new snow Sunday into Monday. Longtime Aspen local, worked at the Viceroy Snowmass. Surfaced via the CSAR sidecountry-is-backcountry piece which recounts it as the April-2011 Aspen sidecountry fatality following the Feb-2011 Snowmass Sands Chute death (id 130). Date = incident Monday (article 2011-04-05, Tuesday).
